mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuations and increase the attractiveness of equities relative to fixed income.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the positive returns in FEDFUNDS low periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% monthly change signals an imminent tightening of monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between CPIAUCSL monthly change and 20-day returns is positive or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative returns in triggered instances are not significantly more negative than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS monthly growth > 0.5%) indicates a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction signal (UNRATE < 4.0% AND PAYEMS monthly growth > 0.5%) is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the positive returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In recessions (GDPC1 growth < 0%), a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals an accelerating economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the signal (GDPC1 growth < 0% AND UNRATE > 4.0%) is positive or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative returns in triggered instances are not significantly more negative than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units with a monthly drop exceeding 1% signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST condition (HOUST < 1200 and monthly decline > 1%) and 20-day returns is positive or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative returns in triggered instances are not significantly more negative than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) and rising consumer prices (CPIAUCSL > 252.0) signals a stagflationary environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction signal (INDPRO < 105.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 252.0) is positive or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative returns in triggered instances are not significantly more negative than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO < 105.0 and 20-day returns is positive or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative returns in triggered instances are not significantly more negative than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
